tasks.name: Link
tasks.owns: UDP socket and fixed I/O buffers
tasks.detail: Moves command datagrams to Command and serialized telemetry to the ground. Nonblocking I/O keeps outgoing ACKs and check-ins responsive.

tasks.name: Command
tasks.detail: Validates packets, obtains Mode decisions by copied queue messages, owns command counters and sends committed ACK descriptors to Telemetry.

tasks.name: Mode
tasks.detail: Owns modes and active faults; processes real sensor and watchdog messages before ground requests. SAFE recovery requires fresh, healthy prerequisites.

tasks.name: Telemetry
tasks.detail: Serializes HK, ATT, events and ACKs. Sends actual simulated sensor values; stale/invalid samples use sentinels. Events retain occurrence timestamps during outages.

tasks.name: Sensors
tasks.detail: Samples simulated battery, temperature and stationary angular rates every 100 ms. Fixed-duration test injections change samples or pause this task.

tasks.name: Watchdog
tasks.detail: Reads check-ins and stack marks from all six tasks. Three missed windows flag a stall. Mode and Telemetry receive independent copies; Mode stalls are detectable but permanent Mode/Watchdog failure requires hardware reset.

modes.detail: Initialization only. Enter SAFE within 2 seconds.
Ground-controlled recovery. Automatic sensor recovery never leaves SAFE.
Normal operation. HK period is configurable from 250 to 10,000 ms.
Enter from NOMINAL below 20% battery. Recover at 30% if no critical fault is active.

packets.name: HK
packets.fields: Mode · sensors · counters · dropped events · watchdog flags · six stack marks

packets.name: ATT
packets.fields: Angular rates x, y, z · signed millidegrees/second

packets.name: EVENT
packets.fields: Event ID · severity · two signed parameters
